name: Weaviate Open-Source Self-Hosted
free_limit: Self-hosted Weaviate core vector database supports vector and keyword/hybrid search, metadata filtering and collections without a vendor-imposed core software query quota; BSD-3-Clause code is free to run.
watch_out: The repository has mixed licensing: code outside the wl directory is BSD-3-Clause; separately licensed enterprise features need a valid license key. Self-hosting, storage, backups, security and model APIs are not included; managed Weaviate Cloud is a separate plan.
